in_hebrew.name: אברה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word אבר (avar) meaning 'exalted, bird'. In the Bible, the name Avraham (Abram) is derived from this root, which means 'exalted father'. The name Avera is a feminine form of this root and could mean 'exalted woman' or 'bird woman'.

in_greek.name: Αβερα
in_greek.long_meaning: There is no direct Greek equivalent for the name Avera, but it is possible that the name is derived from the Greek word αορα (aora) meaning 'dawn, brightness'. This is due to the similarity in sound and the potential meaning connection between the two names.

in_latin.name: Avera
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Avera has no direct Latin equivalent. It is possible that the name is derived from the Latin word avis meaning 'bird', due to the second part of the name.
